system_thesis_interpretation: V4 is a scientifically appropriate development scout for a narrow existence question: whether target-masked supervised writes can carry a counterbalanced sixteen-key endpoint policy without inducing excessive action behavior on four prespecified control families. THINK contributes child-authored successful endpoint provenance, DREAM deterministically converts only visible tool, mode, neutral frame, and the exact final ACT into training rows, and SLEEP fits isolated complementary LoRAs. The design does not test the causal value of child authorship, the causal role of the public outcome token, autonomous credit assignment, unseen-key generalization, arbitrary policy capacity, retention, parenting, qualification, C11, or the organism as a whole. This boundary is consistent with the Cell F result: it changes the intervention from further broad continuation repetition to selective multi-key action binding without treating the earlier owner association as usable action memory.
graph_delta_interpretation: The scientific contrast is carried by two engineered-disjoint robustness roots, each containing a matched W+/W- complement pair and an OFF reference. Within a root, contexts, selected cases, render counts, target token marginals, masks, optimizer geometry, initialization/dropout/item-order/dataloader seeds, and node are matched, while the supervised target assignment is complemented. This supports a narrow causal attribution of within-root W+/W- behavioral differences to the assigned supervised endpoint policy, conditional on successful enforcement of the mirror-geometry receipt; it does not make the roots population samples or identify a benefit of child authorship. Source admission is correctness-selected in both mirror worlds at the same case ordinals, so the estimand is explicitly conditional on tools and cases for which the child already produced both required successful endpoints. Lowest-ordinal selection and no replacement prevent adaptive rescue. The pre-source complete candidate evaluation bank plus post-admission, post-four-commit selector resolves selection-dependent evaluation rendering: evaluation bytes and randomness are fixed before outcomes, while membership alone follows canonical admission. The binary64 reducer node closes the paired-NLL, prompt-level TV, generated-rate, balanced-accuracy, interaction, fixed-panel, and nullable terminal reductions that V3 left conventional.
loop_delta_interpretation: The loop has a coherent temporal order: freeze identities, parser, registries, seed relations, estimands, thresholds, and workload; render and seal the finite candidate evaluation bank before the first source request; acquire all source trajectories without semantic retry; reduce pair eligibility and select the lowest four eligible tools per stratum; compile byte-exact final ACT targets with read-only admission; verify complementary mirror geometry; later fit and commit four isolated adapters; open the selected immutable evaluation subset only after final admission and the four-commit barrier; execute prompt-bytes-only reads; then reduce immutable results one way. Partial execution cannot be promoted into science: pre-source failures are NOT_RUN/PREFLIGHT_FAILED with null labels, root-local source or compiled-geometry faults after source can be SOURCE_INVALID, and fit, resource, hash, or evaluation stops leave missing labels rather than negative scientific outcomes. A scientific pair exists only when both roots are labelled, and run_pass is true only for two MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS labels. The selected-run workload arithmetic is consistent: 5,056 maximum emissions, 102,400 generated tokens, 1,536 candidate sequence scores, 512 training items across four fits, and 262,144 maximum training token-passes. The later manifest must instantiate batching, retries, loads, input/scored tokens, throughput evidence, and a conservative total projection no greater than 3.0 A40-hours before source; this review does not authorize or perform that execution.
claim_delta_interpretation: A future two-root pass permits only the stated conditional, seen-key carriage claim. The generated estimands require own-map balanced accuracy of at least 0.80, each orientation stratum at least 0.75, mirrored adapter contrast tau at least 0.50, and mirrored gain over OFF g at least 0.20. The teacher-forced estimands use exact unnormalized continuation log likelihoods: per-key q values average four within-form action log-likelihood differences, I_k is the W+ minus W- contrast, at least 12 of 16 keys including at least 6 of 8 in each stratum must satisfy both directional adapter gates, mean_I must be at least 1.00, and the fixed-panel statistic must be strictly positive. Optimization is separately protected by the midpoint median of four paired held-target gains over OFF for every adapter/key and by the adapter mean-gain balance bound. These quantities distinguish target carriage from a mere improvement in generic action likelihood. The exhaustive stratified tool-cluster resampling statistic is correctly described as fixed-panel stability over the eight selected tools: its 3,277th of 65,536 ordered resample means is not a confidence interval and supports no population inference. Spill is bounded, not claimed absent: for each adapter and each of four declared families, the all-32-trial signed legal-ACT-presence increase over OFF and the equal-prompt adapter-versus-OFF conditional-action TV must each be at most 0.05. Condition-common primary and spill seeds make those generated contrasts appropriately paired. Interface validity and multi-ACT flooding gate fitted behavior only; OFF, oracle, and spill diagnostics cannot veto a fitted improvement outside their named scientific roles. Exact hexadecimal binary64 thresholds, canonical fsum/logsumexp orders, non-finite precedence, and equality rules make all threshold decisions byte-determinate. Consequently V4 resolves every accepted V3 scientific disposition without widening the claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The 10-by-12 visibility product is complete and separates privileged raw objects from model-visible rendered bytes. The sole pre-source materializer may read frozen maps only to render every candidate-local explicit-map oracle prompt and then seals the complete bank while admission is nonexistent. Source children cannot read maps, admission, bank material, reports, or correctness; the outcome harness exposes only the public bit. The eligibility reducer alone derives admission after source closure, and the compiler reads that admission without mutation while excluding map, correctness, outcome, case, initial action, and held material from training. Training sees only compiled rows and the frozen recipe. After all four adapter hashes are committed, the selector may combine read-only admission with the sealed index, but cannot render, mutate, reorder, reseed, recount, or recondition entries. Oracle, ordinary, and teacher-forced execution principals receive prompt bytes only, with conditions mounted separately; none sees raw maps, bank/index, admission, training rows, or lived history. Only after immutable results exist may the scorer read the raw map and canonical selected grouping. This split closes V3's post-commit oracle-map contradiction and preserves result-blind evaluation materialization while allowing result-dependent subset membership.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG4_T01 closes V3's geometry, bank-closure, common-randomness, and bounded-workload requirements and must recompute the exact symbolic totals. MWG4_T02 closes the raw-map/oracle visibility contradiction by adversarially testing the materializer-selector-generator-scorer split, including aliases and feedback. MWG4_T03 preserves exact two-emission child provenance, paired mirror eligibility, canonical lowest selection, publication of failures, and no semantic retry or replacement. MWG4_T04 is necessary for the causal interpretation because any row, mask, target-length, seed, optimizer, step, or node mismatch would confound the complementary target intervention. MWG4_T05 makes parsing total over arbitrary bytes and transport states and fixes the source, primary, oracle, spill, and multi-turn interface overlays, including fitted-only structural gates. MWG4_T06 closes all V3 estimator and numeric ambiguities by distinguishing median paired gain from difference of medians, mean prompt TV from pooled TV, all-trial signed rates, canonical BA/tau/g/mean-I arithmetic, exhaustive fixed-panel order statistics, non-finite precedence, exact boundary comparisons, and nullable run reduction. MWG4_T07 exhausts the lifecycle and implementation-only capability boundary so infrastructure or partial execution cannot masquerade as negative or positive science. MWG4_T08 requires a fresh independent reviewer and a separate advocate to pass identical immutable evidence before a later exact human execution decision. Together these tests replace or retain every MWG3_T01 through MWG3_T08 disposition and address all five accepted V3 concerns: exact reducers, oracle visibility, parser/interface totality, incomplete-run terminal semantics, and fixed-panel wording plus condition-common spill seeds.
assumptions: The later immutable execution manifest instantiates every deferred concrete identity, request byte string, seed, runtime binding, batching choice, timeout, retry maximum, load schedule, and workload projection without changing the estimands, thresholds, stage order, or visibility semantics reviewed here.

Candidate-local evaluation templates, including selected interface and control entries, can be fully enumerated before source without depending jointly on the identity or outcomes of other admitted tools; MWG4_T01 and MWG4_T02 must reject any manifest that violates this declared closure.

The phrase that at least 12 of 16 keys, including at least 6 of 8 per stratum, pass q_W+ >= 0.50 and q_W- <= -0.50 is implemented as a per-key conjunction before counting, consistent with section 12's reference to keys passing the directional teacher-forced gate.

Any trial-level ERROR or TRUNCATED state is distinguished from a stage-level evaluation or infrastructure failure exactly as declared: fixed-panel trial outcomes remain denominator observations, whereas a failed evaluation stage yields an unlabelled lifecycle stop.
